feature: The net maps' own pieces on generated layers
name: The digit blocks are tile animations
result: The Undernet's script writes 12 tiles to tile 726 every 8 frames and the Aquarium's two write 6 each to tiles 1 and 7 every 12; the maps set exactly those tile numbers where the stored tile set shows digits; set on a generated layer, the game shows a flickering flame and, in the Aquarium, small moving shapes (bubbles: the next entry).
meaning: The digits are no art and no layer draws them; what they stand for is art a layer misses, and the game animates it by itself wherever a layer sets those tiles.
